title: Design System: STRIX UNITED FC27

rastro-blue.scope: Rastro signatures and measured data via --data tokens

kickoff.purpose: Next match kickoff in the Home now block. One per screen.

score.purpose: Last result scoreline and season figures (token --text-score).

display.purpose: Page titles (tagline with a period) and the Home greeting.

headline.purpose: Selected piece title in the Central de mídia toolbar; sheet headings.

title.purpose: Opponent, player and pauta names in rows.

time.purpose: Kickoff times in timetable rows, tabular.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked data metadata: section heads, columns, rail groups, breadcrumb, status. Never an eyebrow above a title.

shadows.name: shadow-raise
shadows.purpose: The one raised object on a page (Home now block).

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Menus, tooltips, player sheet, the Media preview piece (with a line-2 ring).

motion.name: motion-control
motion.purpose: Tabs, segmented controls, menus, toggles, status swaps.

motion.name: motion-section
motion.purpose: Content swaps inside a stable shell (Media sections rise 10px).

motion.name: motion-stagger
motion.purpose: Step between toolbar, stage, actions, rail.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single paper pill per action group.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Abrir Agenda <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--paper-1, #f3f3f3); color: var(--text-on-light, #08090a); font: 800 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { transition: translate 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--paper-2, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { translate: 3px 0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined pill for every non-primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #c9cdd2); font: 800 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms, border-color 140ms, color 140ms, transform 140ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line-3, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)); background: var(--ink-2, #121314); color: var(--text-1, #f5f5f5); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 360px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 8px 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ink-1, #0c0c0d); color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font: 400 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: text; transition: border-color 140ms, background 140ms; } .ds-search span { flex: 1; text-align: left; } .ds-search kbd { padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: 6px; font: 600 11px Inter, sans-serif; color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--line-3, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)); background: var(--ink-2, #121314); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Grouped rail: Clube / Dados / Estúdio; active item is a graphite fill.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 224px; padding: 12px; background: var(--ink-0, #050607); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail p { margin: 16px 12px 6px; color: var(--text-4, #767e88); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail p:first-child { margin-top: 0; } .ds-rail button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms, color 140ms; } .ds-rail button:hover { background: var(--ink-2, #121314); color: var(--text-1, #f5f5f5); } .ds-rail button.active { background: var(--ink-3, #18191a); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-1, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); color: var(--text-1, #f5f5f5); } .ds-rail button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Paper pill for the next match; tracked text status otherwise.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status em { color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-status em.is-next { padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--paper-1, #f3f3f3); color: var(--text-on-light, #08090a); } .ds-status em.is-outline { padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); }

components.name: Timetable with Now Line
components.description: The signature: hairline rows with the now line drawn in at the current minute.
components.css: .ds-tt { width: 440px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-1, #f5f5f5); } .ds-now { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 30px; } .ds-now time { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-now i { position: relative; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f5f5f5, rgba(245,245,245,0.08)); transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-line 560ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } .ds-now i::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -3px; left: -1px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f5f5f5; } @keyframes ds-line { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: none; } } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px 28px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 64px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-1, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); } .ds-row time { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-crest { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-3, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-row div { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-row b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-row small { color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 12px; } .ds-row em { color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-row em.is-next { padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f3f3f3; color: #08090a; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-now i { animation: none; } }

components.name: Now Block
components.description: The one raised object on the Home: status, kickoff numerals, fixture, lineup state and action.
components.html:
HOJE · EM 50 MIN

AMISTOSO

21:10

Strix United × Maquina

Escalação ainda não definida
components.css: .ds-nowblock { display: grid; gap: 20px; width: 560px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: 20px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 0% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.045), transparent 70%), var(--ink-1, #0c0c0d); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03) inset, 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); color: var(--text-1, #f5f5f5); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nowblock header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nowblock header p { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-nowblock header p.m { color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); } .ds-nowblock header i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f5f5f5; } .ds-nowblock strong { font-size: 108px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.86; letter-spacing: -0.055em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-nowblock h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-nowblock h3 span { color: var(--text-4, #767e88); font-weight: 400; margin: 0 12px; } .ds-nowblock footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-1, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nowblock footer button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #f3f3f3; color: #08090a; font: 800 12px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nowblock footer button:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-nowblock footer button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245,245,245,0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pauta List
components.description: Central de mídia pauta: hairline rows, 1px active rule, readiness dots.
components.css: .ds-pauta { width: 248px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pauta button { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 2px 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 68px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-1, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #c9cdd2); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms, color 140ms; } .ds-pauta button::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; left: 0; width: 1px; background: #f5f5f5; opacity: 0; transform: scaleY(0.4); transition: opacity 200ms, transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-pauta button:hover, .ds-pauta button.is-active { background: var(--ink-1, #0c0c0d); color: var(--text-1, #f5f5f5); } .ds-pauta button.is-active::before { opacity: 1; transform: none; } .ds-pauta button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245,245,245,0.72); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-pauta b { grid-column: 1; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-pauta small { grid-column: 1; color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 12px; } .ds-pauta em { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: center; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 10.5px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-pauta em::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--text-4, #767e88); } .ds-pauta .is-ready em { color: #f5f5f5; } .ds-pauta .is-ready em::before { background: #f5f5f5; box-shadow: none; } .ds-pauta .is-incomplete em::before { background: var(--state-warning, #e8b04a); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Next-match Chip
components.description: Topbar pill with the next fixture; hidden at 900px and below.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px 0 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink-1, #0c0c0d); color: var(--text-1, #f5f5f5); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms, background 140ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--line-3, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)); background: var(--ink-2, #121314); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245,245,245,0.72); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-crest { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-3, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)); } .ds-chip > span:nth-child(2) { display: grid; text-align: left; } .ds-chip small { color: var(--text-3, #8e969f); font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-chip b { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
STRIX UNITED is the club's own room at night, read as a timetable. The ground is near-black ink, type is off-white Inter at heavy display weights with tabular numerals, and structure comes from hairlines rather than boxes. Most content sits directly on the ground as rows divided by 1px lines; only one object per screen gets lifted onto a raised ink surface (the next match on the Home, the preview piece in the Central de mídia, the Agenda's list frame).

The signature is the now line: a 1px off-white hairline with a 7px dot that marks where the night stands inside the timetable. It draws in from the left on the Home and in the Agenda, and the same mark sweeps down the generated videos as their scene transition. The product and its social pieces speak one language: same ink stage, same type, same hairlines, same now line.

Color carries no decoration. The UI is monochrome; hue appears only as system state (success, warning, danger) and inside partner scopes (Rastro Blue in the "Powered by Rastro" mark, Next Clubs and competition colours in their own surfaces). Density follows the Agenda, the reference surface: generous row heights, firm type contrast, nothing ornamental.
keyCharacteristics: Ink ramp ground (#050607 up to graphite #2a2b2c) with off-white type in four tiers.
Hairline rows (1px, 6–16% white) instead of cards.
One elevated object per view; everything else is flat on the ground.
Inter only; contrast from size, weight (800 for display) and tracking; tabular numerals for every time, score and count.
The now line as the single recurring signature, in the app and in the videos.
Paper-white pill for the one primary action.

rules.name: The Data-Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means measured: --data on EA values, ratings, trends, progress and data marks. Never on structure, buttons, surfaces or decoration.

rules.name: The State-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only when the system is reporting a state. A row, header or piece never takes a hue to look lively.

rules.name: The One Paper Rule
rules.body: Paper white is the only filled light surface. One primary pill per action group; the rest is outlined or text.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every time, score, count and date renders with tabular numerals (`time`, `.tabular`, `[data-tabular]`).

rules.name: The Tagline Title Rule
rules.body: Page titles are short declarative taglines that end with a period ("Elenco FC 27.", "Central de mídia.", "Boa noite, Dornellas."). The period is intentional.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a page title. The route name lives in the topbar breadcrumb; uppercase labels are reserved for data metadata (section heads, columns, status), never as an overtitle.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: A view lifts one object. Lists, ledgers and section content stay flat on the ground.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset and softly blurred black. No zero-offset glows, no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do build on the ink ramp and four text tiers from `src/design/tokens.css`; read tokens, never literals.
Do divide content with 1px hairlines (line-1 rows, line-2 section heads) and keep it flat on ink-0.
Do lift exactly one object per view onto ink-1 with the Raise or Pop shadow.
Do use the now line to mark the present wherever a timetable or a generated scene shows the night.
Do set every time, score and count in tabular numerals at 800 weight.
Do use the paper pill for the single primary action and outlined pills for the rest.
Do keep motion to decelerating entrances (140ms micro, 200ms controls, 320ms sections, 560ms hero) and collapse it to 1ms under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do render missing data as "—" and write honest empty states (max 46ch, text-3).
donts: Don't let Rastro Blue or any hue into Strix structural UI; colour is for state and partner scopes only.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker label above a page title; the breadcrumb already names the route.
Don't mark state with thick coloured side stripes on rows or cards; active rows use the 1px off-white rule or a fill step.
Don't use zero-offset glows, hard offset shadows, bounce or parallax.
Don't wrap rows in individual cards or build dashboards of metric tiles.
Don't truncate opponent or player names; wrap in the app, shrink-then-split in the videos.

drift: Command palette still renders as a tile grid, not hairline rows.
src/fc27-brand.css overrides .primary with box-shadow 0 9px 28px #0008, adding a shadow to the flat paper pill defined in src/styles.css.
src/ui/motion/motion.css .motion-tabs (used as the Media format control) carries literal values: 10px/900 labels, 14px/10px radii, gradient thumb #f4f4f5 to #d4d4d8.

Legacy alias tokens (--strix-border*, --strix-text/muted, --fc27-label/line, --sp-*) remain for older layers; the blue and surface aliases were removed; --fc27-label and --sp-kicker are off-ramp literals (#aeb4bb).
